name: 85635 · Sierra Vista, AZ
findings: ZIP 85635 (Sierra Vista) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85635 (Sierra Vista) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
